response.sql: WITH scope_counts AS (SELECT u.acctscope, COUNT(DISTINCT o.orderspivot) AS order_count FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY u.acctscope) SELECT acctscope, order_count, CAST(order_count AS NUMERIC) / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS fraction_of_total, CAST(order_count AS NUMERIC) / AVG(order_count) OVER () AS ratio_to_average FROM scope_counts ORDER BY acctscope;
